items.title: Mom Accused of Munchausen Syndrome by Proxy After Child, 2, Underwent Surgery
items.summary:
A mother in West Virginia was accused of Munchausen syndrome by proxy after she allegedly had her 2-year-old child undergo surgery and go to 175 doctor appointments.

Emilee Guzman was arrested on Wednesday, November 18, after the Monongalia County Sheriff’s Office began investigating allegations of medical child abuse and child neglect that involved a 2-year-old and a 9-year-old, according to a criminal complaint viewed by Us .

The Monongalia County Sheriff’s Office confirmed in a press release that Guzman, 29, has been charged with child neglect resulting in serious bodily injury.

Munchausen syndrome by proxy is a mental illness and a form of child abuse in which the “caretaker of a child, most often a mother, either makes up fake symptoms or causes real symptoms to make it look like the child is sick,” according to Medline Plus .

Mom Arrested After 2-Month-Old Son Suffered Brain Injury and Broken Ribs 

Guzman’s husband, Milton Alexander Guzman Cisneros , and a woman named Caitlin Jean Meredith were also arrested in connection to the alleged neglect. Authorities said that Meredith, 32, and Guzman Cisneros, 47, were charged with two counts of child neglect creating risk of bodily injury.

The Monongalia County Sheriff’s Office said in the press release the investigation into the allegations began on October 8 after authorities were alerted to “a child’s reported medical history and the overall welfare of two children.”

Detectives reviewed several records and learned that the 2-year-old had gone to about 175 doctor visits in the past two years. Guzman allegedly told…

items.title: Diddy's Thanksgiving Menu Revealed as Rapper Marks 1st Holiday at New Prison
items.summary:
Sean “Diddy” Combs is celebrating Thanksgiving behind bars, marking his first major holiday at his Pennsylvania prison.

Us has obtained FCI Allenwood Low’s food menu outlining what Diddy, 57, and his fellow inmates will be offered on Thursday, November 26 — and the real question is: turkey or tofu?

The low-security facility is serving up all the fixings of a traditional Thanksgiving meal, including mashed potatoes and gravy, candied sweet potato casserole, sage and onion stuffing, dinner rolls and green bean casserole.

But when it comes to the main course, Diddy and his fellow inmates will get to choose between eight ounces of Turkey or tofu stir-fry.

Dia Dipasupil/Getty Images 
 For dessert, only one kind of pie will be on the menu. FCI Allenwood Low tells Us , it’ll be dishing out pecan pie to the prisoners. Page Six was first to report the news.

This is Diddy’s third Thanksgiving in lockup, but his second since being convicted on two charges of transportation to engage in prostitution in July 2025. He was acquitted on two counts of sex trafficking and one count of racketeering conspiracy. In October 2025, Diddy was sentenced to 50 months in federal prison.

In November 2024, the Bad Records Founder spent the holiday in custody at Brooklyn’s Metropolitan Detention Center while awaiting trial.

Diddy celebrated his second prison Thanksgiving at FCI Fort Dix in New Jersey in November 2025, where he helped organize and fund an inmate-led meal for more than 1,000 men in the federal facility.

items.t: Diddy's Thanksgiving Menu Revealed as Rapper Marks 1st Holiday at New Prison

items.title: ‘Days of Our Lives’ Actor Larry Poindexter Dead at 66 After Being Hit by Car
items.summary:
Soap star Larry Poindexter died on Wednesday, November 18, five days after being hit by a car. He was 66.

A vehicle struck Poindexter while he was crossing the street to pick up food in the Studio City neighborhood of Los Angeles on Friday, November 13, according to Deadline .

Poindexter was subsequently hospitalized and had been scheduled to undergo surgery for broken ribs on Wednesday before he suddenly died. 

His official cause of death has not been shared at this time. Poindexter is survived by his wife, Carol Kritzer , whom he married in 2002, and their twin sons.

‘Days of Our Lives’ Actor Robert Kelker-Kelly Dead at Age 62 

Poindexter’s career spanned four decades, with roles including LAPD Captain Tom Fuller in 2003’s S.W.A.T . He also appeared in 30 episodes of Days of Our Lives , playing two characters: Ben Welch in 1984 and Father Louis from 2014 to 2018. Poindexter was also in several episodes of General Hospital and Santa Barbara. 

“My family was in the biz, but I didn’t start ’til I was 19,” he said during a 2011 interview with Santa Barbara Online about how he got his start in the industry. “I did summer stock theater [musicals] in the chorus, then moved on to working straight plays and then television and movies. My first on-camera job was a TV movie called Thursday’s Child — I played Rob Lowe’s brother.”

In a 2014 interview, Poindexter reflected on where he envisioned his career going while also now balancing fatherhood duties.

“I am the recent, brand-new father of twins, so that seems to be the new job,” he told Starry Mag at the time. “I am going…
items.t: ‘Days of Our Lives’ Actor Larry Poindexter Dead at 66 After Being Hit by Car

items.title: Influencer Allison Kuch Defends Breastfeeding in the Middle of NYC Marathon

Influencer and podcast host Allison Kuch found plenty to celebrate while running the 2026 New York City marathon, just months after giving birth to her daughter, Pepper .  

Kuch, 31, stopped at Mile 17 of the marathon route earlier this month to breastfeed , which she documented on social media and hoped was “empowering for so many women to see.” 

“It was also empowering for me to achieve something like running a marathon so soon postpartum,” Kuch exclusively told Us. “I have yet to have a full night of sleep to this point. I still trained, I was still able to dedicate time to myself. That was all made possible because of the support I have at home.” 

Kuch and her husband, former NFL player Isaac Rochell , welcomed Pepper in April and also share daughter Scottie , born in December 2023. Together, the couple host the Netflix Original podcast “Couldn’t Agree Less,” with new episodes dropping every Thursday.  

Sam Hartman Explains How He'll Balance NFL ‘Day Job’ With ‘Bachelor’ Duties 

“Like, my husband being able to watch the kids while I go on runs, or meet me if the baby is hungry and she doesn’t want to take a bottle,” Kuch explained. “Getting to that moment [at the marathon], I was like, ‘Wow, this feels so good.’ It took so much work to get there.
